scope: Exploratory extension after original RNA results; not prospective study registration or independent validation.
annotation: Frozen EnTAP GO-BP exact shared unit memberships. Resolve exact alt_ids using frozen GO 2026-07-26; discard roots and obsolete terms without replacement. No source GO transfer or ancestor propagation.
semantic_exclusions: All reviewed terms explicitly describing animal-only structures/cells, physiology, receptor pathways or JUN kinase branch are excluded by definitions before results; this is a semantic applicability screen, not an exhaustive formal taxon-constraint audit.
background_for_tests: Unique nonrisk eligible units with at least one remaining valid direct legacy BP label. Include valid labels with <5 units when defining annotated U.
primary_A: One-sided Fisher over-representation in annotated members of the frozen 391 set versus the rest of annotated U; two-sided exact OR CI.
primary_B: Two-sided Fisher term-composition difference between P0up_P1down and P0down_P1up within annotated 391; require >=10 annotated units in smaller group; OR numerator is P0up_P1down.
multiple_testing: BH across all term tests in A and B combined; separate family BH also exported but not used to select main claims.
reportable_rule: combined q<0.05; A OR>1, B either sign; at least 2 hits in enriched class. Report all tests, not just significant terms.
nested_sensitivity: 127 overall and 106 vs21 same universe and eligible terms; all output retained, not new discoveries or independent replication.

bias_sensitivity.strata: rank-average quintiles of unique CDS length x frozen DESeq2 baseMean in annotated U
bias_sensitivity.A: term-wise sum of stratum hypergeometric counts conditional on observed 391 count per stratum
bias_sensitivity.B: conditional hypergeometric direction allocation within selected391, preserving stratum A/B sizes; double-sided absolute deviation from analytical conditional mean
bias_sensitivity.q: BH over A/B empirical p combined
bias_sensitivity.interpretation: Main biological emphasis requires concordant Fisher and bias-adjusted support, not pathway activation.

visual_policy: If supported terms exist, display complete significant terms or deterministic representative clusters (member Jaccard>=0.5, choose smaller background set then GO ID) with full table. If absent, no significant-enrichment bubble plot. Coverage and transparent negative results may be supplemental.
nonclaims: cell-level transcription separate from tissue mixture
